visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with straight black hair and a dark brown sweatshirt with 'Mardi' text and a floral graphic stands before a white wall featuring a grey floral pattern. She gestures with both hands as she speaks directly to the camera, which is positioned at eye level in a medium close-up shot. (2) The woman holds up a brown rectangular box featuring images of cookies and Japanese text titled 'Golden Cheese Langue de Chat.' She then displays a single round, cream-colored sandwich cookie held between her thumb and forefinger against the camera lens to show texture and size. (3) The woman is shown eating the cookie and reacting with exaggerated facial expressions to emphasize its sweetness. A small white fluffy dog appears on her lap, resting quietly. Text overlays in yellow and red appear frequently, such as '尾韻極甜!!!' to emphasize her spoken comments about the snack. (4) She presents a variety of small lifestyle and beauty items to the camera, including a packaged silicone tool from Daiso, a brown pouch of cotton buds from MUJI, and a pack of four grey sphere-shaped adhesive holders. She points to the packaging details while explaining their functions. (5) The woman holds two yellow boxes labeled 'Ahiru Life 2' and subsequently shows two small plastic duck figurines—one wearing a hat and another with a different pose. She holds them close to the lens, smiling and looking delighted by the miniature collectible toys.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks in a friendly and casual tone, greeting viewers and introducing an unboxing session. The background music consists of a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar melody in a major key, playing at a moderate tempo of about 105 BPM with a clear steady beat. (2) As the speaker introduces the cookie box, a sharp 'whoosh' sound effect plays to signal the visual transition, followed by the speaker's enthusiastic narration. Her pitch variability increases as she emphasizes the quality of the item, while the acoustic guitar BGM continues to play steadily. (3) A distinct, crisp 'crunch' sound effect is heard as the woman bites into the cookie. The vocal delivery shifts to high-pitched exclamations to convey her reaction to the extreme sweetness, accompanied by several short 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects for emphasis on her expressions. (4) The audio transitions to a detailed description of lifestyle and beauty products. The speaker's voice is clear, well-enunciated, and enthusiastic. Small, high-frequency digital 'blip' and 'UI' sounds occur whenever new variety text labels appear visually to punctuate her points. The guitar BGM maintains volume. (5) The speaker unboxes figurines, her voice rising significantly in pitch and emotional arousal. A series of high-pitched squeals and melodic 'Ah!' sounds dominate the mix to signal delight. High-frequency 'sparkle' SFX and a final 'ding' sound effect conclude the audio track as the BGM fades out.

Through enthusiastic commentary, tactile demonstrations, and high-energy reactions, she highlights unique products from brands like MUJI and Daiso, creating a sense of joy and community engagement.
